documents.text: On-policy distillation uses student trajectories and teacher feedback.
Reverse KL objective minimizes student teacher divergence. L = KL(student || teacher).
Table 2 reports accuracy on Dataset Alpha 0.91 and Dataset Beta 0.82.
Generalization to turbulence is not validated. Simulation cost is a limitation.
Figure 3 shows the encoder decoder architecture. Pixels are required to verify arrow directions.
